name: Thermal
means: Heat as image: black-body colour ramp from blue to white, no texture at all, glowing bodies against a cold ground.
prose: a thermal image - a blue-to-white heat colour ramp, no surface texture, warm bodies glowing against a cold ground

note: Extremely distinctive and unlikely to be confused with anything.
